j4q.input

Class J4QPressureButton

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.input.J4QToggleButton
      • j4q.input.J4QPressureButton

  • public class J4QPressureButton
extends J4QToggleButton
    Represents a pressure-sensitive button, extending toggle button functionality.

    The J4QPressureButton class provides access to the current pressure value.
